# Gramlot examples 0.3.0

Adds twenty-five Python-first component lessons with JavaScript equivalents:
inputs and labelbox, typed editors, local/callback choices, calendars, formlet,
groupBox copy, switches, command buttons and local/remote field validation.

The gallery loads explicit collections, offers collapsible navigation/source panels,
shared theme and label settings, and Normal/Mobile views retaining the same Data and
drafts. Examples use compact layouts with intrinsic label alignment. The validation
playground uses a single profile scope and relative pointers.

Requires Gramlot 0.3.0 or later and the matching collection-aware hosting packages.
Update installed packages together; rebuild browser bundles for source checkouts.

Qualification: 96 JS and 16 Python tests; 72 common pages across three hosts and two
browser engines (432 startup checks), interaction/RPC checks, clean installations and
strict documentation verification of 71 lessons.
